about.title:
For the love
of cats.
about.description: Kitten Rescue CA is dedicated to helping cats find loving homes. We believe every cat deserves a safe place to land, a little patience, and someone to call their own. Our goal is to connect people with feline companions and make the journey to adoption feel welcoming and personal.
about.signoff:
A new beginning for them.
A new best friend for you.
